title: LONG Events
description: Search events, conference weeks, cities, venues and artist schedules via remote MCP.
summary: Search events, conference weeks, cities, venues and artist schedules via remote MCP.
offersHint: Search events, conference weeks, cities, venues and artist schedules via remote MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://belong.events/functions/v1/mcp-server/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_events
toolsPreview.description: Search for events near a location with optional filters. Returns events with name, venue, date, category, and ticket URL. Use this to help users find events in a city or near coordinates.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a specific event by its ID. Returns complete information including description, venue details, and ticket URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_weeks
toolsPreview.description: List upcoming conference weeks, festivals, and multi-day event series (like ETH Denver, Devconnect, Token2049). Use this to help users plan trips around major conferences.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_week_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a conference week including all its side events. Use this to help users see everything happening during a major conference.

toolsPreview.name: search_event_weeks
toolsPreview.description: Search event weeks by name, description, or city. Use this to find specific conferences or festivals.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_week_cities
toolsPreview.description: List cities that have upcoming event weeks with their counts. Use this to discover where major conferences are happening.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_week_tags
toolsPreview.description: List all tags used in event weeks with their counts. Use this to discover types of conferences available.

toolsPreview.name: get_cities
toolsPreview.description: List cities that have events, with statistics like total events and recent activity. Use this to help users discover active event scenes.

toolsPreview.name: get_venues
toolsPreview.description: List venues in a city with their event history. Use this to help users find popular venues or discover new spots.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Get the DJ/artist schedule for a festival or party event. Returns set times, stages, and artists. Use this to answer questions like 'What time does ANOTR play?' or 'What's happening at AYA on New Year's Eve?'

toolsPreview.name: get_now_playing
toolsPreview.description: Get what's currently playing at festival/party events. Returns live stage information with current artists. Use this to answer 'What's on now?' or 'Who's playing right now at AYA?'

toolsPreview.name: search_artists
toolsPreview.description: Search artists by name and get every performance we know about, across all sources. Use this to find when and where a specific artist is playing. Great for answering 'When does Bonobo play?', 'Where can I see Tale of Us?', or 'Which cities is Nina Kraviz touring?'

toolsPreview.name: get_artist
toolsPreview.description: Get one artist's profile with their upcoming dates and recent history. Provide artist_id, slug, or name. Use this to answer 'Tell me about Tale of Us' or 'What is Objekt up to?'

toolsPreview.name: get_artist_events
toolsPreview.description: List one artist's performances with filtering and pagination. Use this to answer 'Where is Peggy Gou playing in Europe next month?' or to page through a touring artist's full schedule.

toolsPreview.name: list_artists
toolsPreview.description: Browse artists, optionally scoped to a city or country. Ordered by how many performances we track. Use this to answer 'Who is playing in Berlin this month?' or 'Which artists tour most?'

toolsPreview.name: search_organizers
toolsPreview.description: Search organizer profiles enriched from event data. Returns organizer names, source, website/contact details, Instagram profile URL plus handle, and scrape status.
